heroDescription: Choice Souls Media is a global interdenominational network of believers and ministries committed to raising a generation that takes God's word to the nations.

sent-summit-2026.title: Sent Summit
sent-summit-2026.place: Radisson Blu, Ozumba Mbadiwe, Victoria Island, Lagos
sent-summit-2026.summary: A focused apostolic gathering for believers carrying kingdom influence into the marketplace.
sent-summit-2026.message: Engaging your priesthood in the workplace.
sent-summit-2026.details: Sent Summit is the next major public gathering on the site right now. It is positioned as a sharp, practical room for kingdom-minded professionals, founders, creatives, and believers who want their work to reflect the agenda of God.

camp-meeting-2027.title: Annual Camp Meeting
camp-meeting-2027.summary: The next camp meeting gathering, built for deep consecration, teaching, prayer, and kingdom alignment.
camp-meeting-2027.message: The next camp meeting countdown now points to 24 August 2027 at 6 PM.
camp-meeting-2027.details: This is the larger annual gathering on the site, separate from Sent Summit. It is positioned as the broader camp meeting experience for the Choice Souls Media community.

campus-invasion-2027.title: Annual Campus Invasion
campus-invasion-2027.theme: Faith on campus, year after year
campus-invasion-2027.summary: Choice Souls Media's annual campus gathering brings students together for worship, teaching, prayer, and practical encouragement in their faith.
campus-invasion-2027.message: A strategic outreach expression for students and young leaders.
campus-invasion-2027.details: Annual Campus Invasion is CSM's recurring campus gathering for students and young adults. Date to be announced (scheduled for Quarter 4, October 2027).
